name: sdd
description: Spec-driven development: take a spec (or a spec idea) all the way to shipped, reviewed code. Hardens the spec to convergence, writes and hardens a TDD implementation plan, then executes it slice-by-slice with fresh implementer subagents, per-slice spec+quality review with fix loops, a resumable progress ledger, and periodic architecture-coherence checkpoints. Composes the auto-plan hardening loop with subagent-driven development and TDD into one repeatable pipeline.
